what: A SECOND hand-written held-out set, written after the corpus and the parser were fixed against set A. Set A informed which CATEGORIES of phrasing were weak (questions, negations, fragments, several asks in one breath), and fixing categories you learned about from a test set can flatter that test set. This one was written afterwards and measured once, so it says whether the improvement generalises or whether set A had been fitted.
